processing.grid_note: Output grid is approximately 10 m in a local UTM metric CRS. B11/B12 are native 20 m bands resampled to the 10 m output grid.
processing.scl_note: Band 7 (SCL) is a per-pixel classification code, not reflectance. It is used by downstream scripts to mask cloud / cloud-shadow / cirrus / no-data pixels. See https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu (Scene Classification) for the full class list.

resampling.note: Sentinel Hub resamples the requested bands onto the approximately 10 m UTM output grid; B11/B12 remain 20 m native information even when represented on the 10 m grid.
